title: alchemilla vulgaris subvar. lineata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subvar. lineata, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to support menstrual health, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which can help to soothe cramps, calm the digestive system, and protect the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular herb in herbal medicine.
